description: Controlled synthetic role-evidence cases. Names, source passages and events are fictional; these are not news or publications. Person-role labels require the specified evidence, while neutral attribution and source-stated operator roles remain usable. Generic developer roles and substantive tor-dev contributor eligibility accept same-person committed C Tor or Arti code across both topics; project-specific labels require that named project. Existing controls retain their expectations; added controls distinguish role permission from news value and authority.

sources.title: [tor-dev] Multi-relay directory-stream measurements
passages: Taylor posted the following empirical multi-relay report to tor-dev. Systematic measurements across independently operated relays show sustained directory-stream bursts, high CPU use and failed circuit requests. The report states that sustained stream bursts leave relays unable to serve new circuits.
Taylor identifies as a relay operator and asks a correspondent to submit the proposed stream-handling fix as a merge request.
